parent_objective: design no-PPO closed-loop replay for M761 residual head

public_gates: M763 keeps PPO and promotion blocked
M763 requires variant horizon and fault-family stratification
M763 reports closed-loop outcomes separately from exact objective metrics
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train residual or actor parameters
do not tune alphas from replay and call it unbiased
do not claim true four-wheel or single-wheel physics
do not hide closed-loop regressions behind exact objective gains

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_closed_loop: test whether M761 exact residual gains survive rollout
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs no-PPO replay comparing base alpha 0.0 with M761 residual alphas 0.2 0.5 and 1.0
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no replay result, PPO claim, or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if design requires actor or residual training
stop if design cannot reconstruct closed-loop source rows
stop if design lacks normal-history retention metrics
stop if design admits PPO or promotion directly
fallback_plan: if replay reconstruction is too expensive, design a capped source-balanced replay first
if residual wrapper cannot be loaded safely, add loader tests before replay
if alpha comparison is too broad, start with alpha 0.2 plus base
if closed-loop gates are underspecified, write replay metric sanity before implementation
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M762 admits no-PPO closed-loop residual replay design

hypothesis: A no-PPO closed-loop replay evaluator can be designed to test whether M761 exact residual gains survive rollout without actor mutation or promotion.
success_criteria: M763 defines replay inputs and alpha set
M763 defines normal and intervention replay branches
M763 defines closed-loop metrics and stratification
M763 defines sentinel and hard-negative diagnostics
M763 blocks PPO, training, and promotion
failure_criteria: design treats exact objective gains as closed-loop proof
decision_rule: M763 may only design a no-PPO replay evaluator. It must not train, run PPO, mutate actor parameters, or promote a checkpoint.
